summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The First Trust Emerging Markets Equity Select ETF (RNEM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Nasdaq Riskalyze Emerging Markets index. The fund tracks a tier-weighted index of emerging-market stocks selected for low volatility. RNEM was launched on Jun 20, 2017 and is issued by First Trust.

holdings.infoBox: RNEM is an equity ETF with a total of 308 individual holdings. The top holdings are Novatek Microelectronics stock at 4.10%, Titan Company at 3.44%, ANTA Sports Products at 2.72%, Tencent Holdings at 2.60%, and Reliance Industries at 2.28%.
